name: Suunto Activity Exporter
description: Adds an 'Upload to Suunto' button on Biketerra activity pages via Runalyze + sets title via Sports-Tracker.

settings.label: Runalyze Cookie Header
settings.description: Paste your Cookie header from runalyze.com (PHPSESSID=...; REMEMBERME=...).

settings.label: Sports-Tracker Sessionkey (For Activity Title)
settings.description: localStorage.sessionkey from sports-tracker.com. Used to set the workout title in Suunto after upload.
